description: This file defines an Android activity class for the configuration interface of a watch face application, specifically for the openGL watch face on wearables. It sets up the UI component with information about the watch face component, but does not implement any configuration options.

classes.name: OpenGLWatchFaceConfigActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that serves as a configuration template for the OpenGL watch face, displaying the class name of the watch face component.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, retrieves the watch face component name from the intent, and updates the label with the component's class name.
